name: Youko Suzuki
source:
Youko is a popular girl who tries very hard to fit in with the popular crowd at her school. She and Kotoko have a complcated relationship, but deep down she cares about her. She has an on-and-off again boyfriend, and does modelling for fashion brands.

[from [url=https://honeysweetlies.carrd.co/#characters]official website[/url]]
